text:
One may also place a piece of money at the bottom of a basin, and then stoop down gradually, until, the edge of the basin intervening, the coin is lost to view. If an operator then fills the basin with water, the piece of money appears as though the bottom had been raised.

Gaston Tissandier, Popular Scientific Recreations, English edition.
